description.text: International MBA program aims to cultivate business elites and future leaders with international perspectives, innovative thoughts and local insights through developing students’ systematic theoretical knowledge and comprehensive managerial skills. The program adopt fully English teaching model and is specifically designed for those oversea business persons who plan to explore their career in Chinese business area. This program will stick to combine global perspective with Chinese featured courses and integrate eastern business theory with western’s theory. The School of Economics and Business Administration(SEBA) will try its best to construct a firs-class solely English-teaching International MBA program with China economic background. SEBA will actively innovate in all aspects to develop the program, involving the aspect of faculty, teaching model, teaching management, students activity and career development. ◆This program will invite those famous foreign experts and scholars as program teachers of the basic course and theory course, while SEBA faculty will undertake those feature courses and major courses. ◆The program will adopt advanced interactive teaching model and case study, mainly emphasizing students’ participation. Students will master theory knowledge through the case study and real practice. Curriculum Course Name Credit Course Name Credit Managerial Economics 3 Accounting 3 Organizational Behavior 2.5 Strategic Management 3 Marketing Management 3 Macroeconomics 2 Statistical Analysis 3 Chinese Language 4 Operations Management 3 Chinese Culture 2 Financial Management 3 Credits In total 31

duration.text: The IMBA at Chongqing University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6805 USD/per year ￥ 49000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. 8.Copy of article or papers published 9.Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 10.Academic Reference 11.Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. 12.Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).

requirements.text: 1.Be in good Health 2.Non-Chinese citizen 3.applicant should be less than 45 4.Bachelor's degree holder or above 5.English Proficiency 6.TOEFL or IELTS minimum requirements is 550 points or above for TOEFL, and a grade 6.0 or above for IELTS, or other certificate of English proficiency from an approved test. Native English speakers are exempt from this requirement;other candidates whose University courses are taught in English will be considered case by case. Professional Backgrounds 7.Applicants with relevant professional experience or other qualifications deemed appropriciate to the programme applied for may also be considered.
